findings.highlight: Oh well. I guess I’m saved
findings.evidenceJa: 助かったといえば、助かった
findings.governingReading: Shirou grudgingly qualifies that, if this counts as being saved, he was saved.
findings.explanation: The English turns a bleak reservation about his condition into casual relief.

findings.highlight: find out what happened to me
findings.evidenceJa: 丁寧に丹念に調べないと
findings.governingReading: He must examine carefully and painstakingly what he has become.
findings.explanation: The English removes the methodical care and thoroughness of his bodily self-check.

findings.governingReading: Until he has examined himself, he cannot risk moving carelessly.
findings.explanation: The English changes a danger-conditioned prohibition into simple chronology before movement.

findings.highlight: we have to go beneath the Ryuudou Temple
findings.evidenceJa: 今から柳洞寺の地下に行かなくては
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls that they must go beneath Ryuudou Temple now.
findings.explanation: The English removes the immediate time pressure.

findings.highlight: Why am I lying in the shed
findings.evidenceJa: どうして土蔵で倒れてるんだよ
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks why he has collapsed in the shed.
findings.explanation: The English reports only a lying position and weakens the involuntary physical failure.

findings.evidenceJa: だらしなく土蔵に寝っころがっていた
findings.governingReading: He finds himself sprawled untidily in the shed.
findings.explanation: The English removes his posture and its undignified physical quality.

findings.evidenceJa: ジクジクと右手が痛む
findings.governingReading: His right hand aches or throbs persistently.
findings.explanation: The English removes the pain’s ongoing sensory quality.

findings.governingReading: Shirou begins asking Rider what she has been doing until now.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the temporal content of his interrupted recognition.

findings.highlight: So long as she is the one trying to harm you
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方がサクラに危害を加えようとする以上
findings.governingReading: Rider refuses protection because Shirou intends to harm Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English reverses actor and target, claiming Sakura is trying to harm Shirou and making Rider’s refusal illogical.

findings.evidenceJa: ライダーは淡々と説明する
findings.governingReading: Rider explains in an even, dispassionate manner.
findings.explanation: The English makes her delivery light or casual, weakening the cold businesslike threat.

findings.highlight: her hostility creeping up my spine
findings.governingReading: Shirou senses killing intent creeping toward him.
findings.explanation: The English softens an imminent lethal threat into hostility and relocates it as a bodily sensation up his spine.
